desc: Read N, M, and operations; sort by L_i and R_i.
Initialize data structures: max-heap A, min-heap B, count_C=0, used array, in_set markers.
Loop cur from 1 while cur <= right: move ops with L_i == cur from B to A; move ops with R_i < cur from A to C (increment count_C).
Clean top of heaps (pop while used or in_set != current set).
If count_C > 0: pick any such operation, set type=2, used=True, count_C--, finish (break loop).
Else if A not empty: pop max R_i, set type=1, used=True, cur = R_i+1.
Else if B not empty: pop min R_i, set type=2, used=True, right = R_i.
After loop (cur > right), record all other operations as type 0; compute total cost = number of type 1 and 2 used; output K and op choices.
Test on all sample inputs (4 cases) and verify outputs.
Test edge cases: N=1, M=0, intervals covering everything, disjoint intervals, large N.
If any test fails, debug and fix the algorithm/code.
